import reprlib
from typing import Iterable, Collection

class InputMODParseError(Exception):
    pass


def parse_input(s: str) -> Iterable[Iterable]:
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        raise InputMODParseError("empty input line")
    
    lines = s.splitlines()
    r = reprlib.Repr()
    r.maxlist = 100_000
    lines = [r.repr(l).strip() for l in lines if l!= ""]

    items = [x.strip() for x in lines]
    
    assert all(item.split()[0] == "Input: " for item in items)
    
    #comments
    items = [re.split(": ", item)[1] for item in items[1:] if ':'in item]
    #clean up ints
    for i in range(len(items)):
        items[i] = " ".join([str(int(x)) for x in items[i].split(' ')])
    try:
        data = [tuple(x) for x in map(int.items.split(' '), items)]
    except Exception as e:
        raise InputMODParseError(e)
    return data

class InputMODParseError(Exception):

def parse_input(s: str) -> Iterable[Iterable]:

    if not s:
        raise InputMODParseError("empty input line")
    
    lines = s.splitlines()
    r = reprlib.Repr()
    r.maxlist = 100_000
    lines = [r.repr(l).strip() for l in lines if l!= ""]

    items = [x.strip() for x in lines]
    
    assert all(item.split()[0] == "Input: " for item in items)
    
    #comments
    items = [re.split(": ", item)[1] for item in items[1:] if ':'in item]
